column1: # *** THREE GAZETTE RECORDS THIS ARCHIVE DID NOT HOLD - 20 September 2026. ***
# Found while running a CONTROL, not while searching for them. The target was Paul Raymond
# Lerena's 2001 estate notice; the control query 'Lerena' returned 42 documents, and three of
# them are new. *** The target itself was NOT reached - see the last row. ***
# *** TIER: SNIPPET ONLY. *** The search index is open; the document viewer sits behind a bot
# challenge which was not worked around. Nothing below has been read on the page itself.
*** Transvaal Provincial Gazette no. 4793, 11 December 1991, page 75 ***
column2: ...spection during normal office hours at the office John Landman, *** Ricardo Juan Carlos Lerena *** ... behalf of Madeleine Ross, Brian John Town Clerk...
column3: *** GAZETTE OCR INTERLEAVES COLUMNS. *** The words 'John Landman' and 'Ricardo Juan Carlos Lerena' sit beside each other in the snippet and *** that is not evidence they sit beside each other on the page *** - a two-column notice reads across the gutter. No relationship between the names is asserted.
column4: *** NEW. *** Ricardo Juan Carlos died 21 December 1994, so this falls in his lifetime. A township notice is a *** property fact ***, and this archive holds none for him.

column1: *** Transvaal Provincial Gazette no. 4796, 18 December 1991, page 50 ***
column2: The same matter a week later: "...*** ESTABLISHMENT OF TOWNSHIP (WYSIGINGSKEMA 2595) *** ... Landman, *** Ricardo Juan Carlos Lerena *** ..."
column3: Same OCR caution. *** Wysigingskema 2595 *** is the one hard handle in it - an amendment scheme number is searchable in the Transvaal town-planning records.
column4: *** NEW ***, and it gives the pair of notices the shape of a standard two-week township advertisement.

column1: *** South Africa Government Gazette, Legal Notices B, no. 18373, 24 October 1997, page 165 ***
column2: ...Witwatersrandse Plaaslike Afdeling) In die saak tussen *** ABSA BANK BEPERK, Applikant, en LERENA *** ...
column3: *** The snippet cuts off before the respondent's forenames ***, so WHICH Lerena is unknown. 1997 is after Ricardo Juan Carlos's death, so it is not him in person.
column4: *** NEW, and deliberately not attributed to anyone. *** A Witwatersrand Local Division action by ABSA against a Lerena. The forenames are one page-view away.

column1: *** THE TARGET THAT WAS NOT REACHED: Paul Raymond Lerena ***
column2: Estate notices indexed at *** Government Gazette 22032, 9 February 2001, page 35 *** and *** 22107, 9 March 2001, page 78 ***, both Gauteng. He is in the commercial index and *** has never been read from the gazette itself. ***
column3: A name search for him returned nothing - *** but that is NOT a null. *** The control proves the search works; what is unknown is whether the 2001 volumes are in the corpus, and *** OCR of a name is exactly what a search misses. *** The page could not be opened to check.
column4: *** UNTESTED, NOT ABSENT. *** Reading page 35 would do two jobs at once: settle whether *** P. R. Lerena Racing Stables, Randburg *** is Paul Raymond (row 50 records that as a reading, not a fact), and *** take the last-but-one person off the commercial index *** that row 17 is about.
